q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Short answer
- This week so far (2026-10-12..2026-10-13) is materially weaker than the comparison (2026-10-05..2026-10-06): Net sales down 48.5%, orders down 45.7%, ad spend down 39.1%, and the operating loss widened by ₹1,24,537. (See evidence below.)

Key evidence (previous → current)
- Net sales: ₹2,53,916 → ₹1,30,771 (−48.5%). — Measured (metrics_query)
- Orders: 127 → 69 (−45.7%). — Measured (metrics_query)
- Ad spend: ₹1,44,446 → ₹87,980 (−39.1%). — Measured (metrics_query)
- P&L net profit (loss): −₹2,209 → −₹1,26,746 (loss increased by ₹1,24,537). — Measured (metrics_query)

Why this happened (what the data shows)
- The platform / campaign mix explains most of the drop: the diagnosis located the fall in net sales in paid channels and a small set of campaigns (verdict = located_cause_not_identified: the tool found where the change sat but could not prove a single upstream cause). — Measured (diagnose_metric_change)
- Measured concentration:
  - Meta platform decline (single-day decomposition used by the diagnosis) explained ~67% of the change; meta fell from ~₹69,321 to ~₹6,290 on the focal day. — Measured (diagnosis; day-level)
  - One campaign/ad dropped to zero: campaign TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE (campaign_id 120250681379400783 / ad TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE) fell from ~₹32,137 → ₹0 and accounts for ~34% of the identified change. — Measured (diagnosis)
- Accounting decomposition (exact): lower product net sales and gross sales were the largest numeric components of the net-sales reduction; declines in contribution margin and product COGS also feature in the bridge. — Measured (diagnosis bridge)

Confidence & data notes
- The period totals and bridge are exact; the diagnosis did not find a single causal upstream driver (label: located_cause_not_identified). Day-level breakdown flagged meta and the named campaign as hotspots. 2026-10-13 is partial and some tax fields failed to fetch. — Measured / Data note

Suggested next checks (Hypotheses to test)
- Verify that the flagged campaign/ad was paused, budgeted down, or disapproved on/after 2026-10-05; check Meta account delivery and creatives/pixel. — Hypothesis
- Run a focussed diagnose_metric_change on Orders and on ad_platform=meta with drivers [clicks, landing_page_views, ad_spend] to test whether delivery, CTR or landing experience caused the drop. — Hypothesis / Next step
